behavior: SharedTokenFilter attaches accounting custody once per domain, shared by aliases created before attachment. It destroys mask payload before releasing charge; registration keys and contract metadata retain no mask.

ControllerStorageContract validates complete lifetime declarations and unique shared capacity against the additional host allowance. Full sampling/controller quotes remain conservative and do not subtract a scalar shared total.

Run binding and step preflight validate unchanged shared identities/capacities. Decisions preserve owner provenance and reject same-size substitution or raw-borrow bypass before native submission.
Controlled Allowed-mask declarations cover retained pre-override and final masks. Text facade controllers and prepared wrappers preserve shared ownership and provenance.

Loaded-model composition defers fingerprint and mask construction until runtime acquires unquoted domain authority. Exact storage is registered and attached before release, including models that never start inference.

A live reservation rejects the deferred factory before invocation. Unquoted initialization is exclusion authority, not a promised model-loading allocation bound. Error/unwind retires new payload before authority.
Explicit error-source wrappers preserve WorkingMemoryError through controller/storage/backend failures. Independent reviews found no concrete ownership, accounting-cycle or lock-ordering defect.
